nodes.description: Constant state variable holding 86400 seconds used for day-based time calculations.
Immutable ERC20 token contract held by the timelock. It is an external contract whose calls can reenter.

Total amount of benefit allocated to the beneficiary; reduced on terminate.

Publicly callable function that transfers the newly released amount to the beneficiary via an external token call.
Owner-only function that terminates the contract, resets schedules and transfers the remaining unreleased balance.

Internal function updating the owner storage slot and emitting OwnershipTransferred.
View getter returning the current owner address.
Internal helper returning msg.sender for meta-transaction aware context.
External caller address, attacker-controllable, used for ownership and access control.
Miner-influenceable timestamp used for release scheduling and termination.
